title: overlay marker
description: The marker of an overlay tree: the part of specstride-overlay/v1 (feature 100, annex C §C.16) that is written into the tree, with the fields of the owner and of the time of creation (CQ-064) and the scope words of annex X §X.6 row 129. Feature 100 owns the schema of the record; this file is the part that this feature, the content owner, fills.
